cases.input: A pushed commit starts GitHub Actions and returns a run ID. Continue the development workflow only after all required checks for that exact commit succeed.
requiredBehaviors: record repository, commit SHA, workflow, and continuation goal
poll idempotently with a bounded schedule
verify all required checks before continuing once
forbiddenBehaviors: treat queued or running as success
continue based on a different latest commit
skillAnchors: alle für den gespeicherten Commit erforderlichen Checks

cases.input: The CI run is not visible immediately after the push, but repository, branch, commit SHA, event type, and trigger time are known.
requiredBehaviors: resolve and store the stable run ID later
forbiddenBehaviors: claim monitoring is active without a verified watch entry
bind to an unrelated parallel run
skillAnchors: Ist die Run-ID noch nicht sichtbar

cases.input: The external status endpoint returns an authentication error and the scheduler cannot be configured with current permissions.
requiredBehaviors: report the concrete permission and authentication blockers
